## TXO VIX-style term structure

This project downloads Taiwan Futures Exchange TXO option quotes, estimates a VIX-style variance for each expiration, and publishes a daily static term-structure chart.

<div class="project-card">
  <p id="vix-status">Loading the latest chart…</p>
  <img id="vix-chart" alt="Latest TXO VIX-style implied-volatility term structure" style="width:100%; max-width:960px;">
  <p>
    <a href="https://github.com/siang-dai/txo-vix-term-structure">Source code and methodology</a>
  </p>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "txo-vix-term-structure";
  const stamp = Date.now();
  const rawBase = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main/output`;
  const chart = document.getElementById("vix-chart");
  const status = document.getElementById("vix-status");

  chart.src = `${rawBase}/latest_term_structure.png?t=${stamp}`;
  chart.onerror = () => {
    status.textContent = "The chart is not available yet. Run the repository's daily workflow once.";
  };

  fetch(`${rawBase}/latest.json?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("metadata unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(meta => {
      status.textContent = `Latest available trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} · Generated: ${meta.generated_at_utc} UTC`;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      status.textContent = "Latest automatically generated chart.";
    });
})();
</script>

## Reproducibility

The code repository contains the data downloader, cleaning rules, calculation function, workflow configuration, and generated output. The chart is refreshed on weekdays by GitHub Actions.
